title: Regional Service-Call Sales Tax on Optional Coverage Add-Ons Visit Fees
content:
**Tax schedule extract.** The rider visit fee of an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider service request carries the service-call sales tax rate in Bridgewell's tax schedule for the region where the base homeowner property lies. The region is read from the property ZIP code recorded on the base Homeowner Service Contracts contract.

| Property ZIP code | Region | Service-call sales tax rate |
|---|---|---|
| 75000 through 79999 | Texas | 0.0825 (8.25 percent) |
| 43000 through 45999 | Ohio | 0.0575 (5.75 percent) |
| Any other ZIP code | | None |

The tax is charged on the whole pre-tax rider visit fee: the fee is multiplied by one plus the rate, and the taxed fee is rounded to the cent once.

**Hypothetical figures.** A pre-tax rider visit fee of USD 120.00 on a property in ZIP code 78701 becomes USD 129.90 (120.00 multiplied by 1.0825). The same fee on a property in ZIP code 43215 becomes USD 126.90 (120.00 multiplied by 1.0575). On a property in ZIP code 46204 it stays USD 120.00. A pre-tax fee of USD 95.50 in ZIP code 78701 is 103.37875 after tax, rounded once to USD 103.38.
